div.head: Northu 25
div.ab: Gif preost circan miswurðige, þe eal his wurðscipe of sceal arisan, gebete þæt.
Gif preost circan miswurðige, þe eal his wurðscipe of sceal arisan, gebete þæt.
Wenn ein Priester [seine] Kirche missachtet, aus der all sein Ehrenrang entspringen soll, büsse er das.
If a priest dishonours [his] church, from which all his rank of honour should arise, let him atone for it.
If a priest treats disrespectfully the church from which all his dignity must spring, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest dishonors the Church, from which all his honor must come, he is to atone for that.

note.seg: ‘entehrt’ Schmid, besser ‘treat disrespectfuley’ Toller; gemeint ist wohl das Reinhalten der Kirche für den Gottesdienst allein, frei von weltlichem Reden, Tun, Trinken; das nennt Can. Edg. 26 arwurðnesse.—Bis 44 enden die Bestimmungen mit ‘büsse er das’. Vielleicht ist überall ‘12 Ör’ hinzuzudenken, die 6—18 dastehen; s. Gl Rechtsbruchbusse 4

‘dishonours’ Schmid, better ‘treat disrespectfully’ Toller; what is meant is probably keeping the church clean for divine service alone, free of worldly talk, action and drinking; Can. Edg. 26 calls this arwurðnesse. — Up to 44 the provisions end with ‘let him make amends for it’. Perhaps the ‘12 ora’ that stand in 6—18 are to be understood throughout; see Gl Rechtsbruchbusse 4
